label.en: ● Definition 1B.1 — Rational Function Asymptotes, Removable Holes & Oblique Quotients
label.ar: ● تعريف 1B.1 — الوحدة 1B · الدوال النسبية وسلوك الأطراف وخطوط التقارب ونظرية ذات الحدين

body.en: For a rational function \( r(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)} \): if a factor \( (x - c)^m \) appears in both \( P \) and \( Q \) with at least as high multiplicity in \( P \), then \( x = c \) is a removable discontinuity (hole); otherwise \( x = c \) is a vertical asymptote. When \( \deg(P) = \deg(Q) + 1 \), polynomial division \( P(x) = (mx + b)Q(x) + R(x) \) yields the slant (oblique) asymptote \( y = mx + b \).
body.ar: For a rational function \( r(x) = \frac{P(x)}{Q(x)} \): if a factor \( (x - c)^m \) appears in both \( P \) and \( Q \) with at least as high multiplicity in \( P \), then \( x = c \) is a removable discontinuity (hole); otherwise \( x = c \) is a vertical asymptote. When \( \deg(P) = \deg(Q) + 1 \), polynomial division \( P(x) = (mx + b)Q(x) + R(x) \) yields the slant (oblique) asymptote \( y = mx + b \).

body.en: First-Principles Justification: Completing the square on \( ax^2 + bx + c \) gives \( a\!\left(x + \frac{b}{2a}\right)^2 + \left(c - \frac{b^2}{4a}\right) \), which simultaneously establishes the vertex coordinates, discriminant condition \( \Delta = b^2 - 4ac \), and quadratic root formula.
body.ar: البرهان الجبري: بإكمال المربع للمقدار \(ax^2 + bx + c\) نحصل على صيغة الرأس والمميز \(\Delta = b^2 - 4ac\) بدقة تامة.

body.en:
Problem: Express \( f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 11 \) in completed-square vertex form and find its minimum value.

Solution: Halving \( -6 \) gives \( -3 \), so \( f(x) = (x - 3)^2 - 9 + 11 = (x - 3)^2 + 2 \). Minimum value is \( 2 \) at \( x = 3 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد صيغة إكمال المربع للدالة \( f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 11 \).

الحل: \( f(x) = (x - 3)^2 + 2 \) والقيمة الصغرى هي \( 2 \) عند \( x = 3 \).

body.en:
Problem: Find the value of \( k \) for which \( y = 2x + k \) is tangent to \( y = x^2 - 6x + 14 \).

Solution: Equating gives \( x^2 - 8x + (14 - k) = 0 \). Setting \( \Delta = (-8)^2 - 4(14 - k) = 0 \) yields \( k = -2 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد قيمة \( k \) التي تجعل المستقيم \( y = 2x + k \) مماساً للمنحنى \( y = x^2 - 6x + 14 \).

الحل: بوضع المميز \( \Delta = 0 \) نجد \( k = -2 \).

label.en: Worked Example 1B.C — Rate of Change & Tangent Slope
label.ar: مثال محلول 1B.C — معدل التغير وميل المماس

body.en:
Problem: Find the instantaneous rate of change of \( g(x) = x^3 - 9x^2 + 27x + 2 \) at \( x = 5 \).

Solution: \( g'(x) = 3(x - 3)^2 \), so \( g'(5) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
body.ar:
المسألة: أوجد معدل التغير اللحظي للدالة \( g(x) = x^3 - 9x^2 + 27x + 2 \) عند \( x = 5 \).

الحل: \( g'(5) = 3(2)^2 = 12 \).
